title: Typhoon warning: southern coast
description: Typhoon approaching from the south. Very strong winds and heavy rainfall expected along the Seogwipo coast within 24 hours. Coastal trails and outdoor activities suspended.

title: Hallasan Seongpanak trail closed
description: Seongpanak trail to the Hallasan summit closed due to landslide risk after 180mm of overnight rainfall. Hikers advised to postpone summit attempts.

title: 1100 Road partially flooded
description: Sections of the 1100 Road between Eorimok and Seongpanak are flooded after heavy rain. Drive with caution; expect delays or temporary closure.

title: Jeju-Mokpo ferry cancelled
description: All high-speed ferries between Jeju and Mokpo cancelled today due to 4m waves in the Korea Strait. Services expected to resume tomorrow morning.

title: Heat wave advisory in Jeju City
description: Daytime temperatures reaching 34C in Jeju City. Elderly visitors and hikers should avoid midday outdoor activity and stay hydrated.

title: Strong wind advisory: eastern coast
description: Sustained winds of 60 km/h along the eastern coast including Seongsan and Udo. Coastal road driving hazardous for high-profile vehicles.

title: Olle Trail Route 7 section closed
description: A 2km section of Olle Trail Route 7 near Oedolgae closed for erosion repairs. Detour signs posted; the rest of the route remains open.

title: Dense fog on Hallasan summit
description: Visibility below 50m around the Hallasan summit and Witse Oreum area. Hikers should postpone summit attempts until fog clears.

title: Rockfall risk: Geomunoreum trail
description: Small rockfalls reported on the Geomunoreum crater trail after recent rains. Guided tours continue with helmets; independent access restricted.

title: Flash flood watch: Cheonjiyeon valley
description: Flash flood watch for the Cheonjiyeon and Cheonjeyeon waterfall valleys following upstream rainfall. Keep away from stream banks.
